report: Multiple Tags selection ### 📑 I have found these related issues/pull requests I don't know the answer to this question. ### 📝 Description Hi, I've created multiple tags for my monitors. A few of them have one tag but a few have multiple tags. - Location 1 has Tag A, B and C - Location 2 has Tag B and C and D Now if I filter in the menu on Tag B, it shows Location 1 and 2, that's correct. But then I click on Tag D also in the filter menu. It displays two green check marks but the second filter is not applied. So I keep seeing Location 1 and 2 but I should only see Location 2. ### 👟 Reproduction steps Apply multiple tags to the monitor and filter them on the left side. See screenshot. ### 👀 Expected behavior It should display combined results ### 😓 Actual Behavior It displays only the results of the first applied tag ### 🐻 Uptime-Kuma Version Version: 2.0.2 Frontend Version: 2.0 ### 💻 Operating System and Arch Apline Linux (Docker) ### 🌐 Browser Chrome ### 🖥️ Deployment Environment services: uptime-kuma: image: louislam/uptime-kuma:2 container_name: uptime-kuma ### 📝 Relevant log output ```bash session ```

evidence.quote: I think we implicitely choose OR if multiple filters are applied. [...] So not a bug [...] If I select two filters, I expect both to be shown. This is consistent with how other sites handle this (amazon & co).

notes: src/components/MonitorList.vue tag filter intentionally matches any selected tag (OR); AND was split out as feature request #6874. Reporter disagreed on UX, so medium.
